## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes, if the change affects the panel or editor
- [ ] Behavior changes have tests
- [ ] New or changed text is in both English and Arabic
- [ ] README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md and comments describe the new behavior
- [ ] No credentials, personal data or build output are included
